title: 阪神JFの後に・可能性、抱いて

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Aah…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I can feel the wind embracing me, and the world looks so… beautiful.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I… I did it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (So this is what it feels like to finish a G1!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I did it… I ran in a G1!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (This means I can actually take on the Triple Tiara!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I found myself absolutely mesmerized by your every stride! Nice going!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pearl…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Getting to compete against you has made me, well… more confident in myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oooh! My heart!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Only fate knows if our paths will ever cross again, but… at least let me say this.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Limitless potential lights our path forward!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Mejiro Dober. I'll see you again someday.

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Mejiro Dober is so cool!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text: Did we just witness the birth of a new Mejiro star?! I'll have to keep my eye on her during the Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I wouldn't expect anything less from Dober.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober comes back wearing a very satisfied expression, the crowd still cheering loudly in her wake.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What are you surprised about? I told you I wanted to do well today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I did say I wanted to do well… and I guess I wasn't all talk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I think I'm ready to take on the next race.
choice_data_list: You mean the Oka Sho? Yeah, let's win it.
You mean the Oka Sho? Yeah, let's win it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I think I'm ready to take on the next race.
choice_data_list: You mean the Oka Sho? Yeah, let's win it.
You mean the Oka Sho? Yeah, let's win it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: As if there's any other option. I have to win and keep my promise with Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Right. I have to keep my promise with Bright, which means I've got to win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And in order for me to do that, well…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And I'll be counting on your help, so…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll see you tomorrow. For training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's get back to training tomorrow, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems this race has given her the tangible results she needed going into the Triple Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems this race has given her the tangible results she needed going into the Triple Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next challenge is going to be a Classic race—the Oka Sho!
